turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hi, how are things with you?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: My son just turned sixteen and wants a debit card. Is that a good idea?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: It can be a great way to learn. Many banks offer teen accounts that you can monitor from your own app.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'm worried he'll spend it all on snacks and games.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: He probably will at first, and that's part of learning. You can set spending limits and get alerts for each purchase.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Should I give him an allowance on it, or

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: A mix works well. A small base allowance, plus extra for bigger chores or a part time job.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I like that. What about teaching him to save?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Try matching whatever he saves toward a goal he picks, like a bike. Seeing it grow is very motivating.
